decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 17/11/06, the erection of a outbuilding 9.1 m long, 3.7m deep and 3.9m in height is lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the outbuilding would not exceed 4m in height with a pitched roof, does not cover more than 50% of the garden and is more than 5m from the rear of the house as extended.
Informative:
 
The detached single storey outbuilding hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as No. 37, Penwerris Avenue and for no other purpose (e.g. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room or office development).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the proposed erection of a single storey outbuilding for use as a store/garage to rear garden of existing house
